text:
Alex K: Heads up — small-batch tail p95 spiked after driver 12.13.4 rollout, seen across Dedicated and prod canaries. CI smallbatch-latency test failing ~30%. :grimacing:
Maria G: Which workload/seq len? any profiler output?
Alex K: Mostly 1-16 token requests (tinyseq). Quick profiler excerpt below — selector flipped kernel path and p95 doubled:
```
selector candidates:
  matmul_fast_v1 score=0.74 latency_est=40us
  matmul_fallback_v2 score=0.82 latency_est=95us  <-- chosen after driver bump
p95 before rollout: 76ms
p95 after rollout: 164ms
```
Jon: Did we change selector logic recently or was there a runtime dep bump?
Samir: I'm running a narrow bisect now. Initial hit points to merge commit def4567890 ("cuda: relax kernel score tie-breaker") merged 36h ago.
CI Bot: nightly perf job https://ci.redwood/integ/4432 shows the same regression (compare baseline vs current).
Richa P: I reproduced locally on an A100 80GB image pinned to driver 12.13.4. The selector tie-breaker change makes the runtime prefer fallback matmul for certain tensor sizes. Quick patch locally reverts the tie-breaker logic and p95 improves:
```
# local test results (tinyseq workload)
baseline (pre-merge): p95=78ms
post-merge: p95=166ms
with-local-revert: p95=82ms
```
Maria G: Can you open a rollback PR and add a regression test that exercises tinyseq kernel selection?
Richa P: Creating PR now, marking as rollback-candidate and adding a tinyseq selection unit test that asserts preferred kernel name remains matmul_fast_v1 on A100. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/889
Samir: Patch applied to staging; running multi-run perf job. Local microbench shows median latency unchanged but tail drops ~50%.
Infra Ops: Pausing driver 12.13.4 rollout in eu-region as requested. :white_check_mark:
Alex K: Thanks. Recommendation: hotfix to release branch (cherry-pick revert), block further driver rollouts until we have selector hysteresis/hardening. Also track any Triton/autotune table invalidations as potential second-order effects.
CI Bot: Perf gate currently blocking merge until perf-smoke passes on release branch.
Jon: Suggest follow-up: add metric to console that alerts when kernel selection changes frequency > 10% post-deploy.
Richa P: Agreed. I'll include telemetry and a small hysteresis so tiny fluctuations in score don't flip chosen kernels.
Samir: I'll push the cherry-pick to release/2026.03 now and run 6h canary.
Alex K: Please post canary numbers here once available. If hotfix looks good we'll roll to prod and then iterate on selector scoring. :eyes:
CI Bot: perf-smoke for PR #889 shows improvement: median steady, p95 improved ~48% vs regressed baseline.
Infra Ops: Hotfix cherry-picked to release/2026.03 and staging canary started.
Alex K: Final ask — add a note to the rollout docs to include kernel-selection smoke when bumping drivers/libraries. Learned this one the hard way.
Jon: +1 :shipit:
Samir: Monitoring tail for 6 hours, will update with graphs.
